newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN SHARES EXPECTED SHARPLY DOWN.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN SHARES EXPECTED SHARPLY DOWN.

text.p: Share analysts said on Friday they saw the shares of brewer Heineken NV falling as much as 25 guilders at the opening from Thursday's 362.70 guilder closing after lower than expected first half results and a profit warning.
Heineken early on Friday announced first half net profit of 297 million guilders, up from a previous 280 million, below analysts' forecasts for net of 308-322 million.
The brewer accompanied the results with a statement that it expected 1996 full year net profit to be "somewhat" lower than 1995's 664 million guilders.
"The expectation's the thing that's going to go against them, the figures weren't too awful," said an analyst.
